entries.title: I Kings 4:1
segments: ¶So King Solomon was king over all Israel.

entries.title: I Kings 4:2
segments: And these [were] his officials: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

entries.title: I Kings 4:3
segments: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

entries.title: I Kings 4:4
segments: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, over the army; Zadok and Abiathar, the priests;

entries.title: I Kings 4:5
segments: Azariah the son of Nathan, over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan, a priest [and] the king's friend;

entries.title: I Kings 4:6
segments: Ahishar, over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda, over the labor force.

entries.title: I Kings 4:7
segments: And Solomon had twelve governors over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household; each one made provision for one month of the year.

entries.title: I Kings 4:8
segments: These [are] their names: Ben-Hur, in the mountains of Ephraim;

entries.title: I Kings 4:9
segments: Ben-Deker, in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;

entries.title: I Kings 4:10
segments: Ben-Hesed, in Arubboth; to him [belonged] Sochoh and all the land of Hepher;

entries.title: I Kings 4:11
segments: Ben-Abinadab, [in] all the regions of Dor; he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon as wife;

entries.title: I Kings 4:12
segments: Baana the son of Ahilud, [in] Taanach, Megiddo, and all Beth Shean, which [is] beside Zaretan below Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as the other side of Jokneam;

entries.title: I Kings 4:13
segments: Ben-Geber, in Ramoth Gilead; to him [belonged] the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, in Gilead; to him [also belonged] the region of Argob in Bashan-sixty large cities with walls and bronze gate-bars;

entries.title: I Kings 4:14
segments: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, [in] Mahanaim;

entries.title: I Kings 4:15
segments: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali; he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife;

entries.title: I Kings 4:16
segments: Baanah the son of Hushai, in Asher and Aloth;

entries.title: I Kings 4:17
segments: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;

entries.title: I Kings 4:18
segments: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin;

entries.title: I Kings 4:19
segments: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, [in] the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan. [He was] the only governor who [was] in the land.

entries.title: I Kings 4:20
segments: ¶Judah and Israel [were] as numerous as the sand by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and rejoicing.

entries.title: I Kings 4:21
segments: So Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the River [to] the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. [They] brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.

entries.title: I Kings 4:22
segments: Now Solomon's provision for one day was thirty kors of fine flour, sixty kors of meal,

entries.title: I Kings 4:23
segments: ten fatted oxen, twenty oxen from the pastures, and one hundred sheep, besides deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fatted fowl.

entries.title: I Kings 4:24
segments: For he had dominion over all [the region] on this side of the River from Tiphsah even to Gaza, namely over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace on every side all around him.

entries.title: I Kings 4:25
segments: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, each man under his vine and his fig tree, from Dan as far as Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

entries.title: I Kings 4:26
segments: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

entries.title: I Kings 4:27
segments: And these governors, each man in his month, provided food for King Solomon and for all who came to King Solomon's table. There was no lack in their supply.

entries.title: I Kings 4:28
segments: They also brought barley and straw to the proper place, for the horses and steeds, each man according to his charge.

entries.title: I Kings 4:29
segments: ¶And God gave Solomon wisdom and exceedingly great understanding, and largeness of heart like the sand on the seashore.

entries.title: I Kings 4:30
segments: Thus Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the men of the East and all the wisdom of Egypt.

entries.title: I Kings 4:31
segments: For he was wiser than all men-than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the surrounding nations.

entries.title: I Kings 4:32
segments: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs were one thousand and five.

entries.title: I Kings 4:33
segments: Also he spoke of trees, from the cedar tree of Lebanon even to the hyssop that springs out of the wall; he spoke also of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.

entries.title: I Kings 4:34
segments: And men of all nations, from all the kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom, came to hear the wisdom of Solomon.
